info.title: Tomorrow.io Weather
info.description:
Bring Tomorrow.io's hyper-local weather intelligence into Power Automate and Power Apps. Turn live forecasts, historical records, and severe-weather events into automated decisions — trigger a flow on tomorrow's high, log daily conditions to a list, or watch for storms along a delivery route, anywhere on Earth.

Two actions work on any Tomorrow.io API key (subject to usage limits): Get timeline and Get on-demand weather events. Four more tap premium datasets — the historical archive, climate normals, weather along a route, and on-demand events on routes — and need a paid plan; called with a free key they return HTTP 403. Create a key, free or paid, at https://app.tomorrow.io/development/keys.

api_key.name: apikey
api_key.description: Tomorrow.io API key. Get yours at https://app.tomorrow.io/development/keys.

post.description: Free tier — works on any Tomorrow.io API key. The flexible Timelines feed: request any data-layer fields over any time range — past, present, or future — at the timestep you choose. This is the most general weather query; use the dedicated realtime/forecast/history actions when you want something simpler.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Timeline request body: location and fields, plus optional timesteps, start/end time, units, timezone, and daily start hour.

post.description: Free tier — works on any Tomorrow.io API key. Evaluate active and upcoming weather events (severe-weather advisories and custom insights) for a location, on demand. Returns events over roughly the next five days with severity, certainty, and a human-readable headline.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: On-demand events request body: a GeoJSON Point location and the insight categories or custom insight IDs to evaluate.

post.description: Paid plan — requires a Tomorrow.io plan that includes the historical archive; a free API key returns HTTP 403. Get observed historical weather for a location over an arbitrary past date range. Data is available up to roughly six days before now — for more recent data use "Get timeline".

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Historical request body: location, fields, timesteps, and the past start/end time range, plus optional units and timezone.

post.description: Paid plan — requires a Tomorrow.io plan that includes climate normals; a free API key returns HTTP 403. Get long-term climate averages for a location across a date range (data aggregated from 2000-2020).

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Climate normals request body: location, fields, and the MM-DD start/end date range, plus optional units.

post.description: Paid plan — requires a Tomorrow.io plan that includes routing; a free API key returns HTTP 403. Get forecast conditions at each waypoint along a route. To check weather events along a route on a free key instead, loop your waypoints through "Get on-demand weather events".

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Route request body: the ordered legs (each a GeoJSON Point plus travel duration) and fields, plus optional start time, timestep, units, and timezone.

post.summary: Get on-demand events on routes (paid plan)
post.description: Paid plan — requires a Tomorrow.io plan that includes routing and on-demand events; a free API key returns HTTP 403. Monitor weather-based insights along a route — severe-weather advisories via a pre-registered insight ID, or a custom condition tree — evaluated separately at the origin, at the destination, and en route. Wrap the route in a "route" object whose legs each pair one or more GeoJSON geometries with a time window; tag a leg with attributes.legType = "origin" or "destination" to match the origin/destination triggers (omit it for waypoints matched by routeTrigger). Supply at least one of originTrigger, destinationTrigger, or routeTrigger.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Route-events request body: the route object (id, overall window, and legs) plus at least one origin, destination, or route trigger.

location.description: Coordinate pair as "latitude,longitude" (e.g. "40.7128,-74.006"), a pre-defined location ID, or a GeoJSON geometry as a JSON string.

timesteps.description: Sampling interval(s): 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 1d, or current. Pass one or more. Server default is 1h.

startTime.description: Start of the range. "now", a relative offset (e.g. "nowMinus6h"), or ISO 8601. Server default is now.

endTime.description: End of the range. "now", a relative offset (e.g. "nowPlus5d"), or ISO 8601. Default depends on the timestep.

units.description: Unit system for the response values. Server default is metric.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. "America/New_York"). Server default is UTC.

dailyStartHour.description: Hour (0-23) at which daily (1d) aggregation begins. Server default is 6.

insights.description: Event categories to evaluate, or custom insight IDs (UUIDs) from your Tomorrow.io account. Categories include: fires, wind, winter, air, thunderstorms, tornado, floods, fog, tropical, marine, temperature, special. Pass several as separate array entries — do not comma-join them.

location.description: Coordinate pair as "latitude,longitude" (e.g. "40.7128,-74.006"), a pre-defined location ID, or a GeoJSON geometry as a JSON string.

timesteps.description: Aggregation interval(s). 1h = hourly, 1d = daily. Pass one or both.

startTime.description: Start of the range. ISO 8601 (e.g. "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z") or relative (e.g. "nowMinus30d"). Historical data lags roughly six days behind now.

endTime.description: End of the range. ISO 8601 or relative (e.g. "nowMinus6d"). Must be at least ~6 days before now.

units.description: Unit system for the response values. Server default is metric.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. "America/New_York"). Server default is UTC.

location.description: Coordinate pair as "latitude,longitude" (e.g. "42.3478,-71.0466"), a pre-defined location ID, or a GeoJSON geometry as a JSON string.

timesteps.description: Aggregation interval. Climate normals only support ["1d"].

startDate.description: Start of the date range in MM-DD format (e.g. "01-01"). 365 days max.

endDate.description: End of the date range in MM-DD format (e.g. "12-31"). 365 days max.

units.description: Unit system for the response values. Server default is metric.

legs.description: Route segments. Each leg pairs a GeoJSON geometry with a duration in minutes.

fields.description: Data layer fields to return at each waypoint (e.g. ["temperature", "precipitationIntensity", "windSpeed"]).

startTime.description: Route start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2026-06-28T14:00:00Z"). Server default is now.

timestep.description: Sampling interval along the route. Server default is 5m.

units.description: Unit system for the response values. Server default is metric.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. "America/New_York"). Server default is UTC.

duration.description: Time spent on this leg in minutes.

GeoJSONGeometry.description: GeoJSON Point or LineString. NOTE: GeoJSON uses [longitude, latitude] order — not [latitude, longitude].

type.description: "Point" for a single coordinate, "LineString" for a polyline.

coordinates.description: For Point: [longitude, latitude]. For LineString: [[longitude, latitude], [longitude, latitude], ...].

RouteEventsRequest.description: Provide at least one of originTrigger, destinationTrigger, or routeTrigger; each trigger takes either an insightId or a conditions tree.

RouteEventsRoute.description: The route to evaluate: an id, an overall time window, and the ordered legs.

id.description: Your identifier for this route (e.g. "route_789"). Echoed back in the response.

start.description: Route start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2026-07-13T08:00:00Z").

end.description: Route end time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. "2026-07-13T18:00:00Z").

legs.description: Ordered route legs. Each leg has its own id, time window, and one or more GeoJSON geometries.

attributes.description: Optional free-form metadata for the route (e.g. {"mode": "road"}).

name.description: Optional human-readable leg name (e.g. "Depot to Hub").

start.description: Leg start time in ISO 8601 format.

end.description: Leg end time in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.description: Optional leg metadata. Set {"legType": "origin"} or {"legType": "destination"} to match this leg to originTrigger / destinationTrigger; omit legType for waypoints matched by routeTrigger.

locations.description: One or more GeoJSON geometries covering this leg.

RouteEventTrigger.description: Provide insightId or conditions, not both.

insightId.description: A pre-registered insight UUID from your Tomorrow.io account.

conditions.description: A condition tree (AST). Example — precipitationIntensity greater than 0: {"type": "OPERATOR", "content": {"operator": "GREATER"}, "children": [{"type": "PARAMETER", "content": {"parameter": "precipitationIntensity"}}, {"type": "CONST", "content": {"const": 0}}]}. Operators: EQUAL, GREATER, GREATER_EQUAL, LESS, LESS_EQUAL, NOT_EQUAL, AND, OR.
